These DLLs were extracted with tools/pyi_dlls.py from afterglow-windows-x86_64.exe of
Afterglow v0.3.0-beta.6 (https://github.com/harmonic-afterglow/afterglow/releases/tag/v0.3.0-beta.6),
whose SHA-256 matched the release's SHA256SUMS:

Corresponding source:
- libconcord: https://github.com/harmonic-afterglow/concordance (Afterglow's fork, GPL-3.0),
  upstream https://github.com/jaymzh/concordance
- the other libraries (libusb, hidapi, libzip, libcurl, OpenSSL, zlib, the MinGW runtime and
  their dependencies) are MSYS2 MinGW packages; their sources and licences are listed at
  https://packages.msys2.org/ under each package's name.
- how the bundle is built: .github/workflows/bundle.yml in the Afterglow repository.
